turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! After he, she and it, add -s to the verb in the present simple. Example: I work. She works. After verbs ending in -sh, -ch, -s, -x or -o, add -es: He teaches English.

Try this: Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
turns.judgeInput:

Target form: EN-F-A2-GR-third-person-s (he, she and it with -s). Learner level A2. First language Arabic.
Session 1.
W1 (wrong) strength 1: the verb does not change after he/she/it. Its error: leaves the verb unchanged after he/she/it ("She like tea").
W2 (wrong) strength 2: -s goes on every verb and -es/-ies are not needed. Its error: adds -s wrongly or misspells -es/-ies ("She watchs TV", "I plays").
